field.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MiB — export a shorter period.
field.tooManyRows: The file has more than {{n}} rows — split it into parts.
field.badUpload: Invalid file upload request. Refresh the page and try again.
field.badImportOptions: Invalid import options. Refresh the page and try again.
field.delimiter: Choose a separator: semicolon, comma, vertical bar or tab.
field.dateFormatTokens: Date format: only YYYY, YY, MM, M, DD, D, HH, mm, ss and separators (e.g. DD.MM.YYYY).
field.dateFormatParts: The date format needs a year, a month and a day (YYYY, MM, DD).
field.decimalSeparator: Choose a comma or a dot.
field.amountColumns: Choose the amount column or the debit and credit columns.
field.noHeaderRow: No header row with the date column ({{name}}) was found. Choose the date column, or change the separator or the encoding.
field.noAmountColumns: The file has no amount column and no debit and credit columns — choose them.
field.noSuchColumn: The file has no such column — choose another one.
field.notADate: “{{value}}” is not a date in this format.
field.noAmount: No amount: debit and credit are both empty.
field.invalidCsv: The row is not valid CSV (e.g. an unclosed quote).
field.invalidRow: This row does not make a valid transaction.
field.noRateForDueDate: Enter the amount — the {{from}} → {{to}} rate for the due date is not known.
field.subscriptionWallet: Choose a wallet — the subscription has no payment wallet.
field.transferAmount: Enter the amount — the wallets have different currencies.
field.amountPositiveLimited: The amount must be greater than zero and not too large.
field.amountPositiveUnsigned: Enter an amount greater than zero, without a sign.
field.amountPaid: Enter the amount paid, greater than zero.
field.positive: The value must be greater than zero.
field.noDecimals: Enter an amount without a fractional part.
field.decimalPlaces_one: Enter an amount with at most {{count}} decimal place.
field.decimalPlaces_other: Enter an amount with at most {{count}} decimal places.
field.rate: Enter a positive number (at most 12 decimal places).
field.baseOutOfRange: The amount in the base currency is out of range.
field.outOfRange: The value is out of range.
field.assignmentTooLarge: The assignment would be too large.
field.walletCurrency: The currency must be {{currency}} — the currency of the wallet.
field.baseCurrency: The currency must be {{currency}} — the base currency of the household.
field.baseCurrencyRate: This is the base currency — its rate is always 1.
field.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
field.periodTooLong: The period can be at most 366 days long.
field.future: Choose a date in the future.
field.timeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.
field.urlLimited: Enter an address starting with http:// or https:// (at most 500 characters).
field.vendor: Choose a vendor from the list.
field.unknownScope: The list contains an unknown permission.
field.foreignWallet: The list contains a wallet you cannot see.
field.nonMember: The list contains someone outside the household.
field.reminderDays: Reminders: 0 to 60 days before the payment.
field.sameWallet: Choose a wallet other than the source one.
field.sameEnvelope: Choose an envelope other than the source one.
field.sameCurrencyAmounts: With the same currency the amounts must be equal.
field.splitSum: The split must add up to the transaction amount.
field.splitExpenseOnly: Only expenses can be split across envelopes.
field.splitEnvelopes: In a split, envelopes are chosen on the split lines.
field.transferEnvelope: Only a transfer between an on-budget and an off-budget wallet has an envelope.
field.transferLeg: This cannot be changed on a transfer — delete it and save it again.
field.unknownEnvelopeGroup: There is no such envelope group.
field.expenseOnly: Only an expense can be linked.
field.targetDateOnly: The date applies only to an “amount by date” goal.
field.endsByCancel: The end date is set by cancelling the subscription.
field.staleCursor: The list has changed — refresh the page.
field.botLimit: The household already has {{n}} bots — no more are allowed.
field.viewerBots: Someone with the “Viewer” role cannot create bots.
field.ambiguous: The name matches several items — give the full name.
field.url: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://.
field.topic: Topic: 1 to 64 letters, digits, “-” or “_”, no spaces.
field.chatId: Enter a chat_id: a number (e.g. 123456789, negative for groups) or @channel_name.
field.roomId: Enter a room ID starting with “!”, e.g. !abc:example.org.
field.channelSetting: This channel type has no such setting.
field.channelSecret: This channel type has no such secret.
field.unknownChannel: This channel does not exist — refresh the page.
field.unknownEventType: Unknown event type — refresh the page.
field.eventTypeTwice: The event type is given twice.
field.tooManyChannels: Too many channels for one event.
field.oneOf: Choose a value from the list.

reason.duplicate-name: This name is already taken. Choose another one.
reason.duplicate-email: This e-mail address is already in use.
reason.last-owner: The household must have at least one owner.
reason.already-member: This person already belongs to the household.
reason.invitation-used: This invitation has already been used.
reason.wallet-archived: The wallet is archived — restore it to change anything in it.
reason.group-not-empty: The group has envelopes — move or hide them.
reason.envelope-in-use: The envelope has transactions — you can hide it instead of deleting it.
reason.charge-state: This payment has already been settled or skipped. Refresh the page.
reason.transaction-linked: This transaction already pays another subscription payment.
reason.secrets-unavailable: The server has no DENAR_MASTER_KEY, so it cannot save tokens or secrets. Ask the administrator to set it.
reason.smtp-not-configured: The server has no e-mail (SMTP) configured — e-mails cannot be sent.
reason.too-many-channels: You already have 20 channels — delete one to add a new one.
reason.human-only: Only a person, not a bot, can do this.
reason.import-reverted: This import has already been undone.
reason.provider-unavailable: The provider of this connection is not available on this server.
reason.conflict: The data changed in the meantime. Refresh the page and try again.
reason.validation: Correct the data and try again.
reason.bad-request: Invalid request. Refresh the page and try again.

generic.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your network and try again.
generic.server: The server could not complete the operation. Try again in a moment.
generic.rateLimitedFor: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
generic.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
generic.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
generic.notFound: Not found — it may have been deleted.
generic.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again.

delivery.targetForbidden: target not allowed (private network): see DENAR_NOTIFY_ALLOW_PRIVATE
delivery.smtpNoStarttls: SMTP: server does not support STARTTLS
delivery.smtpNoAuth: SMTP: server does not support AUTH
delivery.noMasterKey: DENAR_MASTER_KEY is not set: cannot read the channel secrets
delivery.secretsUnreadable: cannot read the channel secrets (DENAR_MASTER_KEY changed?): set them again
delivery.smtpNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured on the server
